01-06 STAID: Station identifier
08-13 SOUID: Source identifier
15-22 DATE : Date YYYYMMDD
24-28 TX   : Maximum temperature in 0.1 &#176;C
30-34 Q_TX : quality code for TX (0='valid'; 1='suspect'; 9='missing')
